prompt: Lin finds a file marked with the time of Maya’s interview, but it opens with “run-through.” How should she classify it?
promptZh: 琳找到一個檔案，標示的時間和瑪雅受訪的時間相同，但錄音開頭說的是「彩排」。她應該怎麼分類？

options.text: As a run-through, using the spoken opening.
options.zh: 依錄音開頭說的內容，歸為彩排。
options.whyZh: 檔案時間是複製時間；口頭開場才是用來辨認錄音種類的依據。

options.text: As an interview, using the file time.
options.whyZh: 時間只表示何時複製檔案，不能拿來判定錄的是訪談還是彩排。

options.text: As a joint interview because of where it was saved.
options.zh: 依儲存位置歸為聯合訪談。
options.whyZh: 所有錄音都放在同一個資料夾，不能用位置辨認種類。

options.text: As an interview if it was copied before the other files.
options.zh: 若它比其他檔案更早複製，就歸為訪談。
options.whyZh: 複製順序同樣無法說明錄音種類，應聽開頭怎麼標示。

explanationZh: 檔案時間是複製時間；口頭開場才是用來辨認錄音種類的依據。
evidence: Lin’s sorting the recordings. The recorder puts every file in the same folder. How will she tell what’s what? / Say “interview” or “run-through” at the start of each recording. Tell Lin not to go by the file times. Those show when we copied the files, not when we recorded them.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Lin’s sorting the recordings. The recorder puts every file in the same folder. How will she tell what’s what?

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Say “interview” or “run-through” at the start of each recording. Tell Lin not to go by the file times. Those show when we copied the files, not when we recorded them.

vocabulary.note: go by 表示以某項資訊為依據；此處的檔案時間是複製時間。
